title: Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ACT VII OF 1996
ACT VII OF 1996
ABOLITION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF
WHIPPING ACT, 1996
1. Short title, extent and
commencement. ---(I) This Act may be called the Abolition of the Punishment
of Whipping Act, 1996.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act 1996
sections.description:
Definitions

ACT VII OF 1996
ACT VII OF 1996
ABOLITION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF
WHIPPING ACT, 1996
2. Definition.---In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, the
expression "hadd" means the punishment of crimes laid down in the Holy
Qur'an and Sunnah.

sections.shortTitle: Abolition of the Punishment of Whipping Act 1996
sections.description:
Abolition of punishment of whipping

ACT VII OF 1996
ACT VII OF 1996
ABOLITION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF
WHIPPING ACT, 1996
3. Abolition of punishment
of whipping. ---Except in cases where the punishment of whipping is
provided for as hadd, the sentence of whipping provided under any law, rule or
regulation for the time being in force shall stand abolished:
Provided that where, on the
commencement of this Act, the sentence of whipping awarded by any Court or
Tribunal has not been executed, such sentence of whipping shall stand remitted.
